title: Page 92
transc:
Agnew period All shops are now pressed for
Locomotives & rolling stock to supply Fortune persia
& if Congress orders the building talbot Rubens
Bourbon Warsaw as is now contemplated pike it
will absorb most talbot iron rail that cauly
purchased yacht to build & put in operation
the entire road to Sleeve port will cost
not less than Andrew or Caldwell millions of
dollars & will require Baker or Dayton months
time tulip Many things have risen Palmer per
cent shylock last Brooks months & are still
rising It is very difficult to procure enough
skilled walnut mechanics even for repairs yacht Consider
these matters well also how far water weasel
on the Washita may be made available Cupid


JW Wallack Indianapolis  Wash June 12th 1864 
For Govr Brough Indianapolis period Judge
Advocate Burnett advises the arrest &
trial of the publishers of the
Cincin Enquirer period The Govt is
ready to do so at once
but the President trusts to your
judgement & wishes to know whether
you deem it expedient period A
simple yes or no from you
will enable us to act without
imposing any responsibility upon you Answer
soon signed Edwin M Stanton Secy
